unit_texts.tabdata-feature-reporting-completion.ser:
[Unit]
Description=Independent native-feature GitHub completion update

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/data/epanov_s/tabdata
ExecStart=taskset -c 168,170 /data/epanov_s/tabdata/.venv/bin/python -B -u /data/epanov_s/tabdata/runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/code/feature_reporting.py --config /data/epanov_s/tabdata/runtime/parallel-expansion-v1/reporter_config.json --config-sha256 c0028b5179cb55eae031a2ed4494e497c2c2ddf3e828ee61bee365139a04b17b --reason completion
Environment=CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
Environment=MKL_NUM_THREADS=2
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2
MemoryMax=8G
MemorySwapMax=0
TasksMax=128
TimeoutStartSec=300
UMask=0077
unit_texts.tabdata-feature-reporting-completions.pa:
[Unit]
Description=Native-feature scored pairs and terminal summary

[Path]
PathChanged=/data/epanov_s/tabdata/state/parallel-feature-execution-v1/scored
PathChanged=/data/epanov_s/tabdata/state/parallel-feature-execution-v1/SUMMARY.json
Unit=tabdata-feature-reporting-completion.service

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
